test_CUDA_R_constants: test that faiss CUDA_R_32F, CUDA_R_64F, CUDA_R_16F, CUDA_R_8I, and CUDA_R_8U constants are exported
test_IVFPQSearchCagraConfig_default_dtyp: test that IVFPQSearchCagraConfig defaults lut_dtype and internal_distance_dtype to CUDA_R_32F
test_set_lut_dtype_via_constants: test setting IVFPQSearchCagraConfig lut_dtype using faiss CUDA_R_* enum constants
test_set_lut_dtype_via_raw_int: test setting IVFPQSearchCagraConfig lut_dtype using a raw integer value like 2 for CUDA_R_16F
test_dtype_fields_independent: test that IVFPQSearchCagraConfig lut_dtype and internal_distance_dtype can be set independently
